fields.name: peace_officer_authority_excluded
fields.category: what they can and cannot do
fields.description: Whether the statute explicitly states that a private probation provider does NOT have the authority of a peace officer.
fields.sample_quote: A private probation provider does not have the authority of a peace officer.

fields.name: offense_level_limitation
fields.category: what they can and cannot do
fields.description: The categories of criminal offenses for which a private probation provider may provide services (e.g., minor offenses, misdemeanors).
fields.sample_quote: whose services are limited to minor offenses and misdemeanor violations

fields.name: presentence_investigation_authorized
fields.category: what they can and cannot do
fields.description: Whether the provider is authorized to prepare presentence investigation reports in addition to supervision services.
fields.sample_quote: the preparation of presentence investigation reports and the performance of supervision services by a private probation provider

fields.name: funding_mechanism
fields.description: How the private probation provider's services are funded.
fields.sample_quote: funded by a court-ordered fee, to be paid by the defendant

fields.name: dual_service_prohibition
fields.description: Whether the provider is prohibited from simultaneously providing probation services and other compensated services (e.g., therapy, education, rehabilitation) to the same defendant.
fields.sample_quote: a private probation provider that is a licensee may not simultaneously provide to a defendant private probation services and other services for which the private probation provider receives compensation

fields.name: dual_service_exception_distance_miles
fields.description: The minimum distance (in miles) from the defendant's residence within which no alternative licensee exists, triggering an exception to the dual-service prohibition.
fields.sample_quote: no other licensees that provide the services are located within 50 miles of the defendant's residence

fields.name: conflict_of_interest_disclosure_required
fields.description: Whether the provider must disclose financial, personal, or relational conflicts of interest to all parties.
fields.sample_quote: disclose any circumstance that may create or give the appearance of a conflict of interest and any circumstance that may reasonably raise a question as to the private probation provider's impartiality

fields.name: impartiality_required
fields.description: Whether the statute explicitly requires the provider to maintain impartiality toward all parties.
fields.sample_quote: shall maintain impartiality toward all parties

fields.name: confidentiality_required
fields.description: Whether the provider is required to maintain confidentiality or advise parties when confidentiality is not protected.
fields.sample_quote: shall maintain confidentiality or, in cases where confidentiality is not protected, the private probation provider shall so advise the parties

fields.name: solicitation_on_court_property_prohibited
fields.description: Whether the provider is prohibited from soliciting defendants as clients on court property.
fields.sample_quote: may not solicit defendants as supervision clients on any property that operates as a court of justice

fields.name: local_government_overlap_restriction
fields.description: Whether the provider is restricted from operating in a county where a local government agency already provides probation services without a formal contract with that agency.
fields.sample_quote: may not provide private probation in a county where an agency of local government provides probation services unless the private probation provider has entered into a contract with the agency of local government

fields.name: business_license_required
fields.description: Whether the applicant must hold a local business license in the political subdivision where they intend to operate as a condition of state licensure.
fields.sample_quote: submit evidence that a business license to engage in private probation has been issued by the political subdivision of the state in which the applicant intends to establish a business office or offices

fields.name: monthly_reporting_to_county_sheriff_required
fields.description: Whether the provider must submit monthly reports to each county sheriff identifying supervised individuals, their offenses, supervision level, and other relevant information.
fields.sample_quote: shall provide a report each month to each county sheriff where the private probation provider provides private probation identifying each individual currently supervised in the county

fields.name: court_notification_of_supervision_required
fields.description: Whether the provider must notify the court that it is providing supervision services to a defendant.
fields.sample_quote: notify the court that the private probation provider is providing supervision services to a defendant

fields.name: defendant_service_choice_required
fields.description: Whether the provider must give defendants a list of all available licensees for required assessments or treatment and allow the defendant to choose among them.
fields.sample_quote: provide the defendant a list of all available licensees that provide the assessment, treatment, or other services; and permit the defendant to select a licensee

fields.name: written_informed_consent_required_for_dual_services
fields.description: Whether written informed consent from the defendant is required before a provider may simultaneously deliver probation and other compensated services.
fields.sample_quote: the private probation provider obtains the defendant's written informed consent

fields.name: board_composition
fields.description: The required membership categories of the licensing board.
fields.sample_quote: one member representing the administrative office of the courts; one member representing the Department of Corrections; two members licensed as private probation providers; and one member from the general public
